notes.title: 🎉Ping Pong Deluxe is 1 year old!🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472680/8d79e08ab32b8fb3e5907e935242faa47e27e240.png[/img]
Ping Pong Deluxe was released exactly one year ago today. I hope one or the other has fun with my game. I appreciate the positive and negative feedback. 
When my game was returned and there was a reason, I tried to fix the error or improvement as quickly as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472680/922b477cf86c2c708f82114a1745fb440bdfef69.png[/img]
From:
[b]Wednesday, August 21st at 10am GMT-7 (7pm CEST)[/b] 
until
[b]Wednesday, August 28th at 10am GMT-7 (7pm CEST)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472680/8bdeaf2bd0740fe71bab9205602af47c9dcbd939.png[/img]
The biggest changes in the game this year summarized:
[list]
[*]Local multiplayer now supports two Controllers
[*]New PowerUp “Small Player”
[*]Steam Cloud save
[*]Ping Pong Deluxe is now also available for Linux
[*]Difficulty level can be changed
[*]4 different melodies
[*]AutoColor Match
[*]In the custom difficulties there is now "BlockGoal"
[*]8 mew items - Goal Colors
[*]If you have double items in your inventory, you have the chance to get 5 keys to your 25Xp
[*]Monthly challenges are added
[*]Better controller support
[*]Many many bugfixes...
[/list]
If you find bugs or have ideas for the game, feel free to post them on the official Ping Pong Deluxe server!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/bpBw3dzrzD]Discord[/url]

Thanks for playing,
Tschutscha Games
